effects.name: Ruin Incarnate
effects.desc: Base AC becomes 17 + Wis mod (min +1) — ONLY if that is higher than your current AC; if your AC is already higher, end or edit out this effect. You also have Advantage on attacks against Bloodied creatures (apply with -adv). 10 minutes.

effects.text: While active: **Inexorable Onslaught** — attack **twice** when you take the Attack action. **All Things Pass** — Advantage on attack rolls against Bloodied creatures (apply `-adv` when the target is at half HP or less).

onTrue.text: **Many Roads to Ruin** (L6+): **Elemental Assault** — on a weapon/Unarmed hit you may change its damage type to Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Necrotic (edit the attack's `[type]`). **Increased Might** — add +<<max(1, wisdomMod)>> to your Strength and Dexterity saving throws (apply `-b <<max(1, wisdomMod)>>` on `!s str` / `!s dex`).
**Improved Inexorable Onslaught** (L14+): you may attack **three times** instead of twice when you take the Attack action.
